versions.boundary_condition: Do not apply the preference to a leg for which another time of day is explicitly requested.
versions.condition: When selecting a flight departure time and afternoon options are available
versions.default_action: Prioritize departure options in the afternoon.
versions.exception_condition: Use another departure period when explicitly requested or when no workable afternoon option is available.
versions.name: Prefer afternoon departures
versions.scope_condition: Professional or personal flight legs for which Elena has not specified a different departure period and workable afternoon options exist.

versions.boundary_condition: Apply this only when comparing connecting itineraries; do not infer a general preference for either nonstop flights or flights with a layover.
versions.condition: When evaluating flight itineraries with connections.
versions.default_action: Prioritize itineraries with at most one layover and a short connection that permits a practical transfer and brief break.
versions.exception_condition: Follow explicit current-trip requirements for a different number or duration of stops.
versions.name: flight_connection_limit_preference
versions.preference_value: When a flight connection is needed, prefer no more than one short layover.
versions.scope_condition: Professional or personal flight searches in which Elena is evaluating itineraries that require a connection.

versions.boundary_condition: Do not rank United above other preferred carriers solely from this habit; the evidence only establishes repeated inclusion in multi-carrier sets.
versions.condition: When searching for commercial flights and no current-trip instruction specifies a different carrier set.
versions.default_action: Include United among the preferred carrier options when it is otherwise suitable and comparable.
versions.exception_condition: Use other carriers when United is unavailable, unsuitable for the itinerary, materially worse, or excluded by a current-trip instruction.
versions.name: united_soft_carrier_option
versions.preference_value: United is a recurring acceptable carrier to include among preferred flight options, but is not required or uniquely favored.
versions.scope_condition: Commercial flight searches, commonly from Elena's Denver home base, when she has not named or excluded particular carriers for the current trip.

versions.boundary_condition: Applies only to seat location. If seat selection is unavailable at booking or is deferred until check-in, note that limitation and try to secure a window seat at the earliest available time.
versions.condition: When booking or selecting seats for flights where a seat location preference can be applied.
versions.default_action: Prefer or request a window seat by default.
versions.exception_condition: Use a different seat only if the user specifies another seat preference, needs a different seating arrangement, or no acceptable window seat is available.
versions.name: prefers_window_seat_on_flights
versions.scope_condition: Flights on which Elena is selecting her own seat and has not requested a different location or seating arrangement.

versions.boundary_condition: Apply this per room and do not infer it from the number of travelers or requested rooms.
versions.condition: When selecting a shared hotel room without an explicit request for separate beds.
versions.default_action: Prefer a room with a queen-size bed; a king-size bed may be accepted when offered as a larger alternative.
versions.exception_condition: Honor explicit twin-bed, separate-bed, or other room-specific sleeping arrangements instead.
versions.name: queen_bed_for_shared_hotel_room
versions.preference_value: Prefer a queen-size bed for a shared hotel room when no separate-bed arrangement is requested.
versions.scope_condition: Personal trips where Elena and her spouse will share one hotel room and have not requested separate beds or another sleeping arrangement.

versions.boundary_condition: Do not infer preferences for other room amenities, hotel types, destinations, dates, or prices.
versions.condition: When searching for or comparing hotel rooms.
versions.default_action: Use both an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge as soft amenity criteria.
versions.exception_condition: If otherwise suitable options lack either amenity, confirm whether the preference should be relaxed rather than automatically rejecting them.
versions.name: Prefer an in-room coffee maker and mini-fridge
versions.preference_value: Prefer hotel rooms with both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
versions.scope_condition: Hotel-room searches for Elena's professional or personal stays, especially when irregular event or travel schedules make simple in-room food and drink storage useful.
